Starting in [[Find what version of Firefox you are using|Firefox version]] 142, you can preview links to learn more about a webpage before you open it.

=How to preview a link=
#Click and hold a link for about a second (long press). You can also right-click on a link and choose {menu Preview Link} from the menu.
#A card pops up with details from the page, like a small image, the page title and description and estimated reading time if available.
#;[[Image:linkpreviews]]
#Optionally, you can also use AI to read the beginning of the page and generate a few bullet points. To prioritize your privacy, the [[On-device AI models in Firefox|AI works on your device]]. This means you’ll need at least 3 GB of available RAM to use the optional AI.

=How to configure shortcuts=
#[[Template:optionspreferences]]
#{for not fx152}In the {menu General} page, go to the ''Browsing''{/for}{for fx152}Select {menu Tabs and browsing} on the left and go to the ''Page navigation''{/for} section.
#*To go straight there, click the settings gear [[Image:IG settings]] icon in the preview card.
#Under the option {menu Enable link previews}, uncheck the box for the shortcut.
If you turn off the shortcut, you’ll still be able to preview links if you right-click and choose {button Preview Link}.

=How to configure AI-generated points=
#[[Template:optionspreferences]]
#{for not fx152}In the {menu General} page, go to the ''Browsing''{/for}{for fx152}Select {menu Tabs and browsing} on the left and go to the ''Page navigation''{/for} section.
#*To go straight there, click the settings gear [[Image:IG settings]] icon in the preview card.
#Under the option ''Enable link previews'', uncheck '''Allow AI to read the beginning of the page and generate key points'''.

=How to delete the local Link Previews model=
Opting in to AI key points in Link Previews will download a small language model to your device. If you want to review or remove this model, type '''about:addons''' in the address bar of Firefox and select {menu On-Device AI} from the menu.

On this page, you can:
*'''Review models:''' See which models have been downloaded, what size the models are, and what they’re used for.
*'''Remove models:''' Helpful if you need to manage space on your device, or if you simply don’t use the associated feature or extensions anymore.
You can read more in the article [[On-device AI models in Firefox]].

=How to turn off Link Previews entirely=
#[[Template:optionspreferences]]
#{for not fx152}In the {menu General} page, go to the ''Browsing''{/for}{for fx152}Select {menu Tabs and browsing} on the left and go to the ''Page navigation''{/for} section.
#*To go straight there, click the settings gear [[Image:IG settings]] icon in the preview card.
#Uncheck '''Enable link previews'''.
{menu Preview Link} will no longer appear in the menu when you right-click on a link. And, previews won’t be triggered by using a shortcut.
